title: kalqatitteh xisne
intro: Taturte der uddurut, caylale qasriino ugutteh, assakat le xisneh abtoota kee bohoyle maqarat baxsimte. Ta koboxih exxa mango gadda kee angoyyi dudda luk sugteeh, uxih ken miraacissuh ruubeenih yanin yallih farmo sadih gita dooreenih. Ken aydaadi aydaadi kutbeh addal kaxxa baritto akkuk ayfaf yacee, numma cinniyyih xalootih sumaqta.
clues: Nanu mango dagar maqar kee dadal neh yeceen, ni waktih gersi marih innah.
Nanu kulli fayyale aracal kaxxa xisne kee fayyale qamiddu xisak sugneeh, amotani mannownam akkaluk sugne.
Ni fanak farmoyti nee takkaawisuh ruubeh sugeeh, yalla cabaanam kee ni idoola cabnay nee seecimak ten.
Nanu ninni farmoytal kibal luk esserenno, usun nee fan yemeetenim dubuk Yalla akah taamitannah kee ni abbobti akah taamitannah abte taama caboonuh nee fan yemeeteenim esserak sugne.
Ni baaxo caxaaxuwi buxaaxiiy, raceenaanii kee qayso le booxaaxil barkat luk sugte, takkay immay nanu ninni leeda ninni cayla, ninni Gineenah hinna.
nek garuq sinni kufri kee anqasak, nanu ellecaboh finqitteh bohoy le, naqabi silaytut too mango ayroora kee baritte qanxisse.

options: Fayya le qamidduu kee maqarle sigmah
location.answer: Fayya le qamidduu kee maqarle sigmah

arabic: فَأَمَّا عَادٌۭ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَقَالُوا۟ مَنْ أَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةً ۖ أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَهُمْ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةًۭ ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا يَجْحَدُونَ
verse: As for ʿAad, they were arrogant upon the earth without right and said, "Who is greater than us in strength?" Did they not consider that Allāh who created them was greater than them in strength? But they were rejecting Our signs. (41:15)
